title: scene.snapshot.begin (publisher → relay → viewers)
description: Announces a full GLB snapshot that follows as chunkCount binary chunks of chunkSize bytes (docs/protocol.md §6.1–6.3). The relay, not the schema, checks chunkCount == ceil(byteLength / chunkSize) and the global budget (§6.2, §3.3).

sceneVersion.description: MUST be greater than every version used so far in the session (§6.2, §8.4).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete GLB, repeated in scene.snapshot.end (§6.2, §6.4).

chunkCount.description: Number of binary chunks, at most 1024 (§3.3).

chunkSize.description: Payload bytes per chunk except the last: 64 KiB … 1 MiB, SHOULD be 1 MiB (§6.2).

extensionsRequired.description: Absent = []. The relay never parses the GLB, so it copies this value into scene.snapshot.ready (§6.4).

profile.description: Budget profile the GLB was decimated for (§7.5).

nodeCount.description: Informational: Slicer nodes in the snapshot (§6.2).
